offline_scope: All existing M5O/M5P observation windows, including failed development archives explicitly quarantined; newly replay each quality-passing M5O sample and all M5P events/samples/intervals; preserve original classifications
selection: Fresh public scoped NBA/NFL hints, at most three distinct pairs, one 300-second cadence screen to establish recent quality; freeze strongest qualifier then fresh checks and sole 900-second one-pair observation. No repeat screen, substitution after freeze, automatic extension or services.

screen_rule.ranking: minimum half wall, full wall, stable pair id

no_qualifier: Do not substitute volume or open status for measured quality; report Phase B blocked and preserve all failed candidates
episode_rule: Consecutive positive samples within 2 seconds, broken by any intervening rejection/nonpositive sample or window/source-definition/classification change; unchanged combined depth states never independent opportunities; spans are sampled evidence, not continuous exchange validity
created_at_basis: File write clock; corrected initial hand-entered timestamp before capture
